verdict.rationale: A hands-on community user reports that Stagehand has "built in proxies and captcha" that help with adversarial sites. The docs only show browser region selection via Browserbase (four regions), which is a latency and jurisdiction feature rather than geo-targeted proxying. No first-party documentation describes stealth fingerprinting or residential proxy configuration. missing for 10: first-party docs on stealth or fingerprint configuration, documented residential and geo-targeted proxy options, configuration examples, and independent corroboration beyond a single community comment.
